note:
Russia has the best primary source of any tradition in this atlas, and it answers a slightly different question than expected. GOST 31797-2012 'Myaso. Razdelka govyadiny na otruby' is reachable in full text at https://base.garant.ru/70654172/ - Table 1 complete, items I-IV and 1-24, with the paywall starting only at 5.5 Markirovka - and GOST 7595-79, the retail scheme this atlas's cut file is actually drawn to, is reachable in full at http://omgautovar.narod.ru/gost/maso/3.html. Between them, 16 of the 23 cuts carry a quoted GOST boundary line and 12 are graded standard on bounds, which is the best bounds coverage of any tradition in this table.

What GOST 31797-2012 does NOT do is name muscles for the loin. It names no muscle at all for the spinnoy or the poyasnichnyy otrub, so vyrezka = psoas major does fall straight out of it (item 8, poyasnichno-podvzdoshnaya myshtsa) but tonkiy kray = longissimus lumborum does not. Where the standard does name muscles it is excellent and it does so in Russian, muscle by muscle: the hind leg (items 2-7), the tenderloin (item 8) and the shoulder (items 17-21).

The catch is that GOST uses none of the kitchen names. There is no okovalok, kostrets, oguzok, shchup, ssek, podbederok, tolstyy kray, tonkiy kray, pokromka or chelyshko anywhere in it - only 'verkhnyaya chast tazobedrennogo otruba' and the like. Every kitchen-name cut therefore needs a trade bridge from the market name to a GOST item, and those bridges are graded as the weaker link: a GOST muscle list reached through a trade name is trade, not standard. For four of the hip cuts the bridge is not merely weak but contested - one wholesale price list sells 'Bokovaya chast ... (okovalok)', 'Vneshnyaya chast ... (podbederok)' and 'Vnutrennyaya chast ... (oguzok)', contradicting the mainstream retail usage this atlas's cut file follows on three cuts at once, and a producer's own catalogue (primebeef.ru) independently agrees with the price list on two of them. That disagreement is recorded, not resolved: five cuts end up contested and eight inferred, against three standard and seven trade, which is 43% sourced on muscles. One cut, ssek, was downgraded from trade to contested on review precisely because the bridge its GOST muscle list depends on could not be quoted from any source - an honest contested beats a trade grade resting on an unquoted equation.

Where the two standards disagree with each other - the spinnoy/poyasnichnyy line (rib 11/12 in 7595-79, rib 13 in 31797-2012), both shanks (mid-bone in 7595-79, at the joint in 31797-2012), the neck (C3-C5 versus the whole neck) and the triceps (in the lopatochnyy otrub for 31797-2012, on the bone of the plechevoy otrub for 7595-79) - both are quoted and the dispute field says which one the drawn rectangle follows. One correction to the cut file's own blurb is reported rather than edited: zavitok is not a kitchen name the standard never mentions, it is item 12 of GOST 31797-2012 with a real boundary along the costal cartilages from the 8th to the 13th rib.

cuts.dispute: Bounds are standard and the two standards disagree, which is worth recording. ГОСТ 7595-79 - the scheme this atlas's cut file is drawn to - saws across the tibia at the level of its lower third, so its голяшка is only the bottom of the shin; ГОСТ 31797-2012 cuts at the stifle ('по нижнему краю бедренной кости'), so its задняя голяшка is the whole tibia. The drawn rectangle spans hock to stifle, i.e. the 31797 reading. Muscles are inferred: neither standard enumerates the shank, and the one muscle either of them names in this neighbourhood, the икроножная, is explicitly assigned to the hip cut and not to the shank - the opposite of what the US table does, where the round heel is quoted as gastrocnemius and the shank takes the rest of it. The digital flexors and extensors are listed unmodelled from bovine anatomy; nobody sells them by name because the shank is braised on the bone.

(1) The reading this atlas's cut file follows makes оковалок the sirloin - the lumbar meat between the loin proper and the hind leg, 'толстый филей' in the older books - which is the rear end of ГОСТ's поясничный отруб and therefore the back end of the longissimus, the list given above. cuts.dispute: Bounds are inferred because no standard says where the diaphragm divides into мачете and онглет - no standard divides it at all. ГОСТ 32244-2013 treats 'диафрагма' as a single мякотный субпродукт, and ГОСТ 31797-2012 does not list it among the отрубы, which is exactly why this cut carries no сорт. It is a кулинарная разделка piece, not a ГОСТ отруб: the textbook defines it only by the operation - 'Покромку срезают с реберных костей' - and lists it as what is left of the спинно-реберная часть once толстый край, подлопаточная часть and грудинка are off. The muscle list above is inferred from that position: the layer on the outer face of the middle ribs is intercostal muscle plus the sheets that run over it. Note that the same textbook produces покромка twice, once from the front quarter and once from the rear ('Полученную мякоть разделяют на тонкий край, покромку и пашину'), so the name covers a band along the whole rib cage rather than one block; the rectangle here is the front one. The nearest ГОСТ 31797-2012 item is the реберный отруб, whose boundary is quoted, but the standard does not use the word покромка. The Primebeef catalogue heads its ПОКРОМКА section (Short Plate), which is the same band read as an export primal, and files the diaphragm steaks under it - confirming the placement without naming a muscle.

cuts.dispute: Bounds are standard, and the two standards make the шейный отруб very different sizes. ГОСТ 7595-79 gives it only three vertebrae, C3 to C5, because its лопаточный отруб takes C6 and C7 forward with the shoulder - that is the scheme the atlas is drawn to. ГОСТ 31797-2012 runs the шейный отруб from the C2/C3 line all the way back to the first thoracic vertebra, i.e. the whole neck. Both quoted. No standard and no Russian trade source fetched here names a muscle in the neck, so the list is inferred from bovine anatomy. The yellow elastic ligamentum nuchae runs from the poll to the withers through this отруб and is much of why the cut looks sinewy, but it is not a muscle and so is deliberately kept out of the unmodelled list. ГОСТ 7595-79's sort list is quoted: with the пашина, this is one of only two 2-й сорт отрубы.
